items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: And Wallace Davenport and all that bunch was with Victor

ctx.x: Is he any kind of Dwight Newman?

That's Dwight, little Dwight, Dwight's son. Oh you mean Joe? Joe Newman, yeah. Well that's the bunch who was playing with Victor and them that I won the contest against. And Wallace Davenport and all that bunch was with Victor so you know how much they had in the band. Oh yeah. We made 10,000 people stand up and listen.
